# Tableclock

> Tableclock is a free, private, offline-first turn timer for two to eight board-game players.

Tableclock supports count-up, time-bank, Fischer-increment, and fixed-per-turn modes. It stores setups and running clocks locally, provides JSON export/import, and can encode a setup in a shareable URL. It has no accounts, advertisements, or analytics.

## Pages

- [Tableclock](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/): Set up and run a clock.
- [Privacy](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/privacy/): Local storage and privacy details.
- [Terms](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/terms/): Terms and timing limitations.
